meta.name: Rise and Fall
meta.description: The story revolves around the host explaining the show where 4 celebrities, of which 2 in the penthouse, are trying to maintain their position as Rulers while 2 in the basement are fighting to Rise to the Penthouse to topple a Ruler.

videos.title: Kaun Banenge Rulers?
videos.overview: As the contestants enter the Tower, the game begins with Ashneer’s twist, they must confront the fate of either the luxurious penthouse or the struggle of the basement.

videos.title: Basement Ka Torture Shuru
videos.overview: While basement contestants struggle for water, comfort, and survival, the penthouse contestants enjoy luxury and ease. Two worlds, one tower who will handle the pressure and who will crack under it?

videos.title: Barf Ne Lagai Aag!
videos.overview: In Rise and Fall, the Rulers set a tough challenge for the Workers. If the Workers win, they can add money to their Prize Pot but if they fail they risk to lose their earnings to the Rulers.

videos.title: Dhoka, Drama, Hungama!
videos.overview: Drama peaks as the rulers appoint a Lift Operator to decide nominations in the Lift of Judgement. Tensions rise, loyalties are questioned, and every decision carries high stakes. The game turns unpredictable, and no worker is safe.

videos.title: Aarush Vs Arbaz
videos.overview: One Ruler will get a chance to save themselves from the Fall by becoming the Ultimate Ruler while the Workers have a golden opportunity to earn money. Tough negotiations are made, and hard words exchanged and tempers reach their boiling point.

videos.title: Pawan Ka Chakravyuh
videos.overview: The workers hold the power to decide the ultimate Ruler contendership. In the high-stakes Chakravyuh, strategy, skills, and team chemistry will decide which Ruler rises to Power. Alliances, decisions, and team work will determine the fate of the Rulers.

videos.title: Kaun Girega Basement Mein?
videos.overview: The Rulers battle to survive in the Penthouse, while the Workers compete for their chance to rise. In the high-stakes Eggspress delivery Challenge, where balance, speed, and trust will determine who amongst the Workers will rise and who amongst the Rulers will fall.

videos.title: Powerplay Weekend
videos.overview: In Powerplay Weekend, Ashneer takes charge with full-on drama, entertainment, and showdown of greed and ego.

videos.title: Kaun Hoga Eliminate?
videos.overview: In the Powerplay Weekend, A bold twist shakes as the Ruler has to make a decision from Ashneer's den. Clashing opinions and rising tempers spark drama in the Powerplay Weekend. Drama, tension, and entertainment peak as one Worker faces elimination.

videos.title: Dhanashree Ko Mila Dhoka!
videos.overview: At the pool party, the Ultimate Ruler faces a final decision. Loyalty and friendship come under question as people start to put themselves first before the group and The Rulers face a mental test test to win the title of the Ultimate Ruler.

videos.title: Jab Pawanji Met Dhanashree
videos.overview: While Pawan deepens his bond with Dhanashree, The Ultimate Ruler gets a power to directly choose one Worker to rise to the Penthouse. Workers must prove themselves with a pitch. Emotions run high as fears come to light in the battle for power.

videos.title: Akriti Ne Palta Game
videos.overview: The Basketball challenge takes the spotlight. The Ruler has no escape they are bound to fall into the Basement. A game changing move flips the direction of the game. Drama intensifies as the tables turn in a shocking way.

videos.title: Arjun Bana Target
videos.overview: One Worker is targeted for nomination in the Lift of Judgement. The Workers face nominations, but the power to save one is in the Rulers hands. Drama, betrayal, and tension rise as nomination looms over the Workers.

videos.title: Takhta Palat Duur Nahi
videos.overview: The Workers have an opportunity to decrease the defecit between theirs and the Ruler's Prize Pot. They face the Sewage Tank Challenge, with the Rulers setting the level of difficulty. It's a race against time for the Workers to inch closer towards the Takta Palat. One wrong move, one miscalculated strategy can change their Rise to the coveted Penthouse.

videos.title: Kiku Ne Bajayi Band
videos.overview: Pent-up emotions come to the fore as Ashneer gives a reality check to the Rulers and Workers on the Powerplay Weekend.

videos.title: Trustee Ka Beta
videos.overview: Powerplay Weekend brings an unpredictable twist with heated clashes, accusations, and emotions running high. Workers pitch to save themselves from elimination but the final decision is in Rulers hands. The Workers have the opportunity to rise as the Ruler but the power to rise a worker is in Rulers hands.

videos.title: Arbaz Cancels Aarush
videos.overview: Each Worker has put a price tag to themselves in the form of a golden briefcase and is ready to Rise and the Rulers have a chance to increase their Prize Pot amount. The Rulers have to make a tough decision, choose a higher priced Worker and further increase the gap between the two sides or choose a Worker who would be a useful ally.

videos.title: Don't Tell Me Shut Up!
videos.overview: The Rulers get a chance to cancel decisions made by the Ultimate Ruler and save Workers from harsh handicaps, but there is a price involved. And as the reign of the Ultimate Ruler in power comes to an end the Workers get a chance at revenge to choose the next candidates to take on the mantle of the Ultimate Ruler.

videos.title: Comedy Khatam Ladai Chalu
videos.overview: Betrayal is in the air as the Workers face the heat of nominations. And tempers flare within the Rulers as the Ultimate Ruler is given a power to influence the outcome of the nominations.

videos.title: Gira, Gira Kaun Gira?
videos.overview: The Ultimate Ruler must choose two Rulers to decide another’s fate. Their decision ignites chaos, shakes alliances, and stirs deep emotions. As tensions rise, one Ruler faces the Fall and is sent straight to the Basement.

videos.title: Kya Hoga Takhta Palat?
videos.overview: In the Brick Factory Challenge, tension rises as Workers get a chance to earn all the money from the Rulers prize spot. If they fail, the Rulers will claim money from the Workers prize spot. The Rulers will choose the challenge level. Teamwork and coordination will decide the outcome.

videos.title: Ashneer Ne Kiya Roast
videos.overview: Ashneer takes charge of the Red Room and questions the decisions that the Rulers and the Workers have made throughout the week. Every contestant is put up on the stand as their individual gameplay and alliances come into question.

videos.title: Double Dhamaka
videos.overview: The Rulers and the Workers face the heat as the audience reveal statements made by the contestants for each other. And tensions rise amongst the Rulers as a twist in nominations is introduced.

videos.title: Manisha Ke Wild Decisions
videos.overview: With the entry of a new contender the gameplay of the Rulers and Workers is disrupted. To enter the game the wildcard has to make some game changing decisions which force a change of strategies for both the Rulers and the Workers.

videos.title: Time for Takhta Palat?
videos.overview: Once again the Workers have an opportunity to stage a coup by winning the Prize Pot Challenge. The Rulers have to take the risk of betting on the difficulty level of the task. It is a make or break moment for both sides. One side hoping to retain their hold on the Penthouse while the other hoping to win the Challenge and become the new Rulers.

videos.title: Kiku Physically Unfit!
videos.overview: Personal grudges emerge as the Workers and the Rulers are asked to nominate fellow Workers in the Lift of Judgement. The nomination sparks intense arguments and make clear the divide between various contestants.

videos.title: Chal Be Chamchey
videos.overview: The Rulers have to face a challenge to become the Ultimate Ruler, but before they can take on the challenge, they have to face the Workers who have been given the power to eliminate the Rulers they deem unworthy to become the Ultimate Ruler. As pitches are given to retain the contendership for the challenge a fight breaks out between a Worker and a Ruler.

videos.title: Pitch Nahi Karungi!
videos.overview: In the Red Room, the Ultimate Ruler holds the power to decide the weakest Ruler and send them to the basement. Rulers must pitch to survive, as the decision lies in the hands of the Ultimate Ruler.

videos.title: Walkout!!
videos.overview: The Powerplay Weekend heats up as Ashneer gets the Rulers and the Workers call out the dual-faced nature of their fellow contestants. Words are exchanged and rivals almost come to blows. While a question from the audience insights a war of words which sees a contestant stage a walkout.

videos.title: Dhokha
videos.overview: Powerplay Weekend is charged with drama, tension, betrayal, and emotions. Nominated Workers make their final pitches as Rulers decide who faces elimination. Friendships and trust are tested. The twist of ranking each other unanimously shakes the Tower.

videos.title: Dosti Tooti
videos.overview: Family members continue to visit the Workers and the Rulers, boosting their confidence and spreading laughter and joy amongst the rest even though their visit is timed by the clock. But there is sourness in the air as two Rulers struggle to maintain their bond of friendship.

videos.title: Finale Ki Race Shuru
videos.overview: The Workers get a golden chance to rise to the Penthouse, but some will be blocked. The Rulers and Workers will decide which worker will face the block. The Bridge Bungee challenge will decide their fate. Strength and strategy will decide who rises to the Penthouse.

videos.title: Rani Ki Khuli Kahani
videos.overview: ‎The Workers face nomination for elimination in the Lift of Judgement. ‎Tension rises as they have to nominate those who don't deserve to be in the finale week. Heated arguments and clashes erupt. ‎The Rulers also have to nominate one Worker.

videos.title: Aditya Ne Liya Badla
videos.overview: The Rulers for the last time have the oppurtunity to win the Ultimate Ruler title and earn themselves a ticket to the finale week. But the road to the ticket isn't easy as they have to first block their fellow Rulers who they deem as unworthy of becoming the candiadate for the title. Accusations are are raised and things heat up as a Worker decides to exact their revenge against a Ruler.

videos.title: The Mega Fall
videos.overview: The Red Room intensifies as the Rulers face a Mega Fall. ‎Each Ruler must pitch to the Ultimate Ruler to save their place in the Penthouse. ‎But it’s the Ultimate Ruler’s decision who stays and who falls. ‎Clashes, arguments, and high-voltage drama take over the Tower.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Dhokebaaz?
videos.overview: With the Worker's prize pot dissolved, both the Rulers and the Workers are given a chance to increase the winning amount. To increase the the amount the Workers have to correctly answer the questions put forth by the Rulers. Each correct answer will open a locker containing a different amount which will add to their total amount.

videos.title: Ticket To Go Home
videos.overview: ‎Ashneer enters the Red Room and revisits last week’s storm, questioning every move of the Rulers and Workers. He introduces the 'Ticket to Go Home', where they must choose who doesn’t deserve to stay in the game. ‎This twist ignites intense clashes, accusations, and heated debates. ‎The Powerplay Weekend turns into a fiery showdown filled with drama and entertainment.

videos.title: Most Hated Contestant
videos.overview: ‎On the last Powerplay Weekend of Rise & Fall the ‎Rulers and Workers fire sharp anonymous questions at each other. Sharp words are exchanged and ‎a double Elimination keeps the Workers guessing their fate.

videos.title: Rise Pe Hua Rage
videos.overview: As the finale week begins, it's a do-or-die scenario for the remaining Workers in the basement. They are given a challenge which will secure one Worker's position not only in the Penthouse but also in the Finale. As the challenge progresses a fellow Worker is called out for cheating.

videos.title: Sawaal Pe Hua Bawaal
videos.overview: ‎The members of the Press continue their onslaught of tough questions aimed at both, the Workers and the Rulers. And a siren signals the countdown towards the closing of the basement and the Workers get a chance to secure their place in the finale as the fifth finalist.

videos.title: Aakhri Finalist
videos.overview: ‎The Jamnapaar cast put forth a challenge to the Workers, where Workers take on dares to add money to the Rulers prize pot. ‎As the final Basement shutdown begins, two Workers will be eliminated and one will rise as the last Ruler and the sixth Finalists. ‎It’s the final chance to prove themselves, but the decision lies completely in the hands of the Rulers.

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: ‎The Tower stands tall for the most awaited Grand Finale of Rise and Fall. ‎Ex-contestants return to relive their journeys in a night filled with nostalgia, music, and celebration. ‎Celebrity guests set the stage ablaze as emotions run high. ‎All eyes await the moment when the Ultimate Winner of Rise and Fall Season 1 is crowned.

videos.title: Let The Games Begin
videos.overview: Host Virender Sehwag makes his reality debut as fifteen contenders from television, politics, and digital media enter the Tower. The grand premiere kicks off with an audience valuation twist, dividing the contestants into luxury Penthouse Rulers and hard-labor Basement Workers. As the initial hierarchy is established, the Workers prepare for their first shifts to build the collective prize pot, while early tensions and tactical alliances immediately surface.

videos.title: Kiski Palti Kismat
videos.overview: Following the grand premiere where contestants were initially segregated into Rulers (residing in the luxury Penthouse) and Workers/Hustlers (stuck in the gruelling conditions of the Basement), Episode 2 centers on the first major power shift and survival challenge.

videos.title: Lafda Loading
videos.overview: The game of power heats up in Episode 3 of Rise and Fall, as the Rulers throw down a difficult challenge for the Workers. With the Prize Pot at stake, the pressure has never been higher. The rules are simple but the outcome could change everything: if the Workers succeed, they get to add money to the growing Prize Pot. But if they fail, not only do they lose their chance to earn, they also risk their hard-earned amount being snatched away by the Rulers.

videos.title: Hurt Kar Diya
videos.overview: Tensions escalate between the Penthouse and the Basement. A disagreement between Gautam and Priyanka turns personal, altering their dynamic amidst high-stakes decisions.

videos.title: Leech Hai Ye Khoon Choosta Hai
videos.overview: The Workers face a demanding Prize Pot Challenge, where every decision could impact their hard-earned pot. Tensions explode when Manish and Tej Pratap Yadav lock horns over a crucial moment, while pressure mounts across the Basement. With the stakes rising and every cracker counting, will the Workers manage to increase their prize pot?

videos.title: Majdoor Pe Atyachar Karenge
videos.overview: Friction reaches a boiling point as the disparity between Penthouse luxuries and Basement hardships triggers an outright rebellion. With the Rulers imposing stricter demands to protect their privileges, the Workers push back against the constant exploitation, setting off major clashes that threaten to dismantle established alliances and reshape the power ladder.

videos.title: Do Bhai Dono Tabahi
videos.overview: The tension reaches a boiling point after the grueling fireworks task leaves the Workers lagging far behind the Rulers in the Prize Pot. An attempt by the Penthouse to extend an olive branch through food sharing backfires, igniting intense clashes in the Basement. With blame shifting across both floors, alliances are tested, and the game takes a high-stakes turn as the first round of nominations puts the Workers on the firing line.

videos.title: Naagin Vs Nevla
videos.overview: Priyanka and Shehzad's heated equation adds fresh tension to the Penthouse, while Workers get one shot to impress the Ultimate Ruler. With music, dance, mimicry and entertainment on the cards, every performance could make the difference. As the race for the first Rise intensifies, who will steal the spotlight?

videos.title: Teju Bhaiya Dulhania Le Jayenge
videos.overview: Sehwag puts the Rulers and Workers under the spotlight as the first Rise sparks a fresh debate. Meanwhile, an unexpected gesture puts Gautam in a spot, while the first elimination reaches its biggest moment yet. With the final decision in the Rulers’ hands, one question hangs over the tower: who will face the Ultimate Fall?

videos.title: Aa Ab Maidaan Mein
videos.overview: The fallout from the first elimination fuels fresh tension as Gautam and Priyanka lock horns. But the real game begins on the Fortune Floor, where two Rulers face a pressure-packed decision with the prize pot ticking down. One choice could shake the Penthouse and flip the power balance. Who will dare to take the risk?

videos.title: Lalu Ji Dekh Rahe Hain
videos.overview: Priyanka’s first morning in the Basement begins with frustration, while the Rulers gear up for a glamorous Bollywood Party. As the Rulers enjoy a night of food, fun and Bollywood avatars, the Workers watch from below. But just when the party hits its stride, the Lift throws in a twist that turns the celebration into a battle for power. Who will survive the race?

videos.title: Kaun Banega Ultimate Ruler
videos.overview: The race for Ultimate Ruler reaches its biggest moment as Shehzad and Gautam find themselves closer than ever to the ultimate power. While the two contenders prepare for the battle, the Workers are handed a crucial role that could influence what happens next. With tensions rising and every decision carrying weight, only one can claim the throne.

videos.title: Shocking Eviction
videos.overview: The new Ultimate Ruler takes charge as tensions explode in the Basement, but an unexpected announcement changes everything. A sudden eviction forces a crucial Rise, giving one Worker a chance to enter the Penthouse while another contestant must leave the tower. As emotions run high and the game takes an unforeseen turn, who will Rise and who will be forced to Fall?

videos.title: Kya Aaj Hoga Takhta Palat
videos.overview: The Workers enter the Lassi Factory challenge with a chance to turn the game in their favour. Blindfolds, rising pressure and strict Ruler supervision make every move count. But when an unexpected setback shakes their momentum, the Workers must fight to keep their chance at Takhta Palat alive. Will they pull it off or will their opportunity sink in the lassi tank?

videos.title: Aukaat Mein Raho
videos.overview: A crucial decision in the Red Room sparks unexpected chaos as Gautam’s explosive reaction gives way to heated accusations. Meanwhile, Shehzad and Tej’s confrontation turns physical, sending tempers soaring. With emotions running high, what triggered Gautam’s outburst, and what pushed Shehzad and Tej to clash?

videos.title: Lalu Aur Rabriji Ka Surprise
videos.overview: Sehwag is back to revisit the tower’s biggest twists, power shifts and clashes, putting both Rulers and Workers under spotlight. A Bollywood-themed celebration brings performances, entertainment and unexpected moments, but the glamour soon gives way to heated debates. With a special surprise waiting for Tej and emotions running high, what will unfold when the contestants face Sehwag’s questions?

videos.title: Teen Tigada Kaam Bigada
videos.overview: A shocking eviction shakes the tower as Sehwag returns with unexpected surprises! With three wildcards entering the game and a twist that could turn the prize pots upside down, the Rulers and Workers face tough decisions. Who will Rise, who will Fall, and how will the newcomers change the game?

videos.title: Darti Nahi Hun Main
videos.overview: A shocking outburst by Sara sends the Basement into chaos as her confrontation with Gautam escalates into a fiery clash. When Kaira gets involved and Priyanka steps in, misunderstandings spread among the Workers, leaving everyone questioning where loyalties lie. Meanwhile, Navratri celebrations bring the tower together, but a surprise power move threatens to change the game.

videos.title: Kaun Banega Ultimate Ruler
videos.overview: The power of the gift cards turns the Ultimate Ruler race into a game of unpredictable choices, leaving contenders disappointed and emotions running high. Meanwhile, Niharika and Rishabh’s personal clash intensifies as the Workers rally together, raising fresh questions about the balance of power. With a major twist awaiting the finalists, who will claim the Ultimate Ruler throne in the Penthouse?

videos.title: Ab Rise Ki Baari Kiski
videos.overview: The race for power intensifies as the workers battle for the Ultimate Ruler throne and a coveted chance to Rise to the Penthouse. While the challenge promises a major shift in the house dynamics, the drama is far from over. With five workers facing a crucial judgement and a shocking twist awaiting them, who will escape danger, and whose journey could come to an end?

videos.title: Spineless Ho Aap
videos.overview: Two emotional exits leave the house shaken, but a mysterious knock at the door brings an unexpected twist! As the game enters its second half, the rulers face a crucial decision that could change everything. With accusations flying, friendships being questioned and old grudges resurfacing, the Red Room turns into a battleground of egos and loyalties.

videos.title: Bhundi Shakal Hai
videos.overview: The game takes an unprecedented turn as Rulers face Rulers and Workers compete against Workers in the Seven Stones Challenge. With a Rise and Fall hanging in the balance, every move counts. But the real fireworks begin when the Red Room decisions trigger heated confrontations, and Sara and Priyanka’s rivalry explodes once again. Who will Rise, and who will face the Fall?

videos.title: Impact Players Ka Dhamaal
videos.overview: The game takes an unexpected turn as two Impact Players enter Rise and Fall, bringing tricky deals and fresh drama. While the Ultimate Ruler faces a crucial decision that could affect the Rulers’ Prize Pot, another tempting offer puts the Workers in a dilemma. But the Lift of Judgement raises the stakes, as difficult choices and explosive confrontations shake up the Basement.

videos.title: Badtameez Kisko Bola
videos.overview: Sehwag’s Powerplay revisits a week filled with heated arguments, emotional moments and rising tensions. As another explosive confrontation leaves tempers soaring and emotions spilling over, the contestants get a chance to reflect on their journey during a special interaction with Sehwag and the Impact Players.

videos.title: Double Elimination Ka Kahar
videos.overview: Sehwag’s Powerplay brings tricky questions, dance moments, a special trailer reveal and heartwarming celebrity messages. But the mood shifts as elimination time arrives. With the audience’s verdict followed by the Rulers’ decision, two contestants face the exit. Who will survive this double elimination?

videos.title: TBD
videos.overview: The Penthouse gears up for an ultimate entertainment night filled with dance, music, mimicry and masti! As the celebrations unfold, the atmosphere is full of energy and surprises. But just when the night seems to be all about entertainment, the Lift delivers a shocking announcement that puts the Rulers in a dilemma.

videos.title: TBD
videos.overview: Niharika’s crucial decision puts the Rulers’ fate and Prize Pot at stake. As the Lift announces a possible Takhta Palat, the Rulers and Workers gear up for the Printing Press challenge. With tensions rising and disagreements brewing, will the Workers turn the tables?

videos.title: TBD
videos.overview: The Printing Press challenge brings a dramatic twist, changing the game inside the Rise and Fall tower. As tensions and excitement continue, Dipali Sharma arrives with intriguing questions, followed by a heartwarming birthday surprise for Shehzad. What lies ahead for the contestants?

videos.title: TBD
videos.overview: The Rulers face a crucial decision as they debate who deserves to compete for the Ultimate Ruler title. With conflicting opinions and disagreements, the race takes a dramatic turn. The Hockey Challenge adds another twist, where a special buzzer can change the scores at any moment. Who will outsmart the others?

videos.title: TBD
videos.overview: Excitement fills the Rise and Fall tower as the Rulers and Workers reunite with their loved ones. Amid emotional moments and heartfelt conversations, a special activity gives the guests the power to influence the Rulers’ fate. What impact will their decisions have?

videos.title: Tu London Ka Chhapri Hai
videos.overview: Family visits continue with emotional moments and a crucial ranking activity. Meanwhile, a heated exchange in the Penthouse sparks frustration. As the contestants celebrate the first week of Takhta Palat, a comment from the Basement triggers an explosive confrontation.

videos.title: Kurta Phir Phatega Iska
videos.overview: Shreya enters the Rise and Fall tower, but her visit takes an unexpected turn as the ongoing clash between Shehzad and Rishabh comes into focus. With questions, confrontations and an open challenge, her arrival adds a new dimension to the conflict. Meanwhile, more family members arrive for emotional reunions and the Decision of Fate ranking activity.

videos.title: Goli Chal Jata Hai !
videos.overview: A ranking twist puts four contestants at risk, triggering intense debates inside the Red Room. Later, discussions on stage grow heated, leading to Sehwag’s unexpected walkout. What unfolds during the interaction that makes him leave the stage?

videos.title: Poonawalla Vs Poonawalla
videos.overview: Sehwag delivers another major googly with an unexpected entry that leaves the contestants stunned. As panelists share their views on the game, heated debates bring personal differences into focus. The arrival of the Chaar Yaar cast adds a fun twist, while the looming eviction keeps everyone guessing.

videos.title: Phir Se Takhta Palat?
videos.overview: One Takhta Palat has already shaken up the Rise and Fall tower, but could the game witness another dramatic power shift? As the Honey Challenge begins and the Prize Pot gap narrows, is another Takhta Palat on the cards?

videos.title: Kya Itihaas Banega?
videos.overview: The Honey Challenge reaches its most crucial phase as the Workers fight for every point. Takhta Palat hangs over the tower, and the Rulers are determined to protect their positions. Will they retain their power, or will the Workers rewrite history once again?

videos.title: Ticket To Finale Kiski?
videos.overview: The journey to the finale takes a dramatic turn as the Rulers face a series of difficult decisions to determine the contenders for the first finalist ticket. With unexpected eliminations from the race and a high-stakes Trial by Fire awaiting the finalists, who will make it one step closer to the grand finale?

videos.title: Sabse Shocking Fall!
videos.overview: The race for the ticket to the finale between Karan and Shehzad reaches its decisive stage. With a challenging task testing their strategy, coordination and timing, only one can secure a place in the finale. Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: #Swaad Hua Kadwa
videos.overview: Judgement Day takes a dramatic turn as Sehwag puts the contestants under the spotlight. With unexpected audience comments, tough questions and revelations from their five-week journey, tensions rise and reactions get intense. What shocking verdict awaits them in the Court of Sehwag?

videos.title: Triple Elimination?!
videos.overview: The game reaches its most shocking stage as three contestants face elimination for the first time in Rise and Fall history! With two exits revealed and one final decision left, the tension reaches its peak. Who will be the last to leave the tower before the finale?

videos.title: Basement Bandh!
videos.overview: The race to the grand finale enters its most crucial stage! The Workers get one final chance to rise, but the path ahead is filled with tricky challenges and mounting pressure. Who will seize the opportunity and secure a place in the grand finale?

videos.title: Kaun Banega Ultimate Winner?
videos.overview: The wait is finally over as the blockbuster grand finale brings the unforgettable journey inside the tower back to the stage. With the finalists facing unexpected twists, exciting surprises and nail-biting moments, the race for the ultimate trophy reaches its most thrilling stage. Who will emerge victorious?
